svg.aria-label: The lagging strand cannot be finished at the end of a linear chromosome, so the chromosome shortens each round
svg.text: 1. The leading strand copies all of its template. The last lagging-strand primer sits ~100 nucleotides from the 3′ end.
2. The RNA primer is removed. That stretch of template cannot be replicated.
3. In the next round the shorter new strand is a template. Each round, the chromosome gets shorter.
